caveats: Geometric similarity index, not planetary: terrain shape alone does not reproduce gravity, regolith, lighting, or chemistry.
Geometric selection score; the displayed index is recalculated by similarity.mjs.

Thermal amplitude: Earth diurnal air temperature (2 m, ERA5) is compared with target surface temperature (Diviner/MCD). Higher-amplitude sites score better; measurements differ in gravity, atmosphere, and surface-versus-air context, so this is not a claim of physical equivalence.
Aridity is Earth-side context from annual ERA5 precipitation; it is not scored against the target because Moon and Mars do not have comparable aridity.
AW3D30 uses the EGM96 geoid while Copernicus uses EGM2008; the difference is effectively constant and sub-meter across a 2.4 km window, so it is negligible for relative terrain metrics.
